name: agent-trust
description: Agent Trust — an open profile and reference implementation for proving what an autonomous AI agent is authorized to do.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/verifier && npm run build -w packages/sdk-ts && npm run build -w packages/mcp && npm run build -w packages/cli && node scripts/fix-esm.mjs
scripts.sbom: for p in packages/*; do (cd $p && npm sbom --sbom-format cyclonedx --omit dev > sbom.cdx.json); done
